Limits

Request body1 MiB
Batch1 to 16 steps
Proof of work20 bits, at the start of a sign-up or sign-in: a few seconds in the browser, done by WallFlowers' window
Argument valuestext or integer
A messageno length of its own: bounded by the request body (1 MiB). Pick a limit that suits your page.
The public page's itemsits 8 most recent resources, and its events
Page document (face)16,384 bytes
A picture156,000 base64 characters; PNG, JPEG or WebP
A link2,048 characters
A member's card16,384 bytes, picture included
What WallFlowers keepsWhat members write through the Door, as a backup

The Door's configuration

These are set by each WallFlowers deployment; the values below are the current ones.

Sessionone hour; ends after 15 minutes without a request, or at session.signOut()
Sessions held at once112, for all of WallFlowers together, not per site: past it, every sign-in anywhere is refused (503) until some end. So sign out what you open (session.signOut()), and have scripts and tests sign out as they exit. A page that only shows the public page's items needs no session at all.
Proof clockeach call's proof within 60 s of WallFlowers' clock
Sign-ins in progress32 per address; each has 1 minute to finish, a new account 5 minutes

Measured latencies for every route are on Routes.
